help.title: Madad

selfie.q: Aapko tasdeeqi selfie ki zaroorat kyun hai?
selfie.a: Yeh tasdeeq karti hai ke profile ke peechay ek haqeeqi shakhs hai. Yeh kabhi awami tor par nahi dikhai jati aur sirf tasdeeq ke liye istemal hoti hai.

subscription.a: Explore+ aapki rozana ki likes ki hadd khatam kar deta hai aur aapko dekhne deta hai ke kisne aapko pehle hi pasand kiya, monthly ya yearly plan par.

reporting.q: Block karna aur report karna kaise kaam karta hai?
reporting.a: Kisi chat se kisi ko block karne se match foran khatam ho jata hai aur woh dobara aap se rabta nahi kar sakte. Report karne se guftagu hamari hifazati team ke paas jaiza ke liye chali jati hai.

changeDetails.q: Kya main baad mein apna shehar ya zaban tabdeel kar sakta hun?
changeDetails.a: Ji haan — apna shehar Edit Profile se update karein, aur kisi bhi waqt Settings se zaban tabdeel karein.

deleteAccount.q: Main apna account kaise delete karun?
deleteAccount.a: Settings se Privacy aur Hifazat, phir Account Delete Karein par jayein. Is se aapki profile, matches, aur paigham hamesha ke liye delete ho jayenge.

safety.q: Agar kuch ajeeb lage to mujhe kya karna chahiye?
safety.a: Chat screen se hi us shakhs ko block aur report karein. Hamari hifazati team har report ka jaiza leti hai.
